title: Reasoning
description: The model's reasoning above its answer: open while it streams, folded to “Đã suy luận trong N giây” when done, reopenable.
when: Models that expose thinking / reasoning text; show it before the AssistantMessage body.

instead.need: A wait with no text yet

a11y: A disclosure button (aria-expanded); the reasoning text is not a live region, so screen readers hear the answer, not every reasoning token.
notes: Pass busy while reasoning streams; once a person toggles it, Reasoning stops opening and closing by itself.
